references.name: WHO Human — Fertile (normospermic)
references.description: Synthetic cell-level CSV with WHO 5th-edition normative human distributions. PR≈55%, hyperactivated≈10%, VCL≈95±18 µm/s. Built from published reference ranges (WHO 2010, Mortimer 1990, Holt 1985); not real-patient data.

references.name: WHO Human — Subfertile (asthenozoospermia)
references.description: Synthetic cell-level CSV mimicking sub-WHO motility profiles. PR≈22%, hyperactivated≈3%, VCL≈55±18 µm/s. Useful as a contrastive reference for the Prediction page.
